title: Lateness Rate Schedule for Late Same-Day Express Deliveries
content:
**Late-express lateness rate.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the lateness rate on a Northgate Same-Day Delivery express order is counted in calendar days from the order date to the fulfilled date, the order date left out and the fulfilled date included:

| Fulfilled after the order date by | Lateness rate |
|---|---|
| three days or more | 90 percent |
| exactly two days | 70 percent |
| a single day | the standard half, 50 percent |

**Hypothetical order dated 12 March.** Fulfilled on 13 March: a single day, 50 percent. On 14 March: two days, 70 percent. On 15 March or later: 90 percent.
